import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import least_squares

N = 150000
n1 = 6              # large entries
n2 = 100            # medium entries
n3 = N - n1 - n2    # tiny entries

# Unknowns: u = log A, w = log B, z = log C  (log-space keeps positivity)
def residual(v):
    logA, logB, logC = v
    A, B, C = np.exp(v)
    total_mass  = n1*A + n2*B + n3*C
    total_log   = n1*logA + n2*logB + n3*logC
    total_xlogx = n1*A*logA + n2*B*logB + n3*C*logC
    return np.array([
        total_mass/N - 1.0,      # sum q_i = N   (q = N*p)
        total_log/N + 10.0,      # sum log q_i = -10 N   (backward KL)
        total_xlogx/N - 10.0,    # sum q_i log q_i = 10 N (forward KL)
    ])

v0 = np.log(np.array([24000.0, 60.0, 4.5e-5]))
sol = least_squares(residual, v0, method='lm', xtol=1e-15, ftol=1e-15, gtol=1e-15, max_nfev=20000)
print('status', sol.status, sol.message, 'cost', sol.cost, 'opt', sol.optimality)
v = sol.x
A, B, C = np.exp(v)
print('A,B,C =', A, B, C)
p = np.concatenate([np.full(n1, A), np.full(n2, B), np.full(n3, C)])
p = p / p.sum()
u = 1.0/N
fkl = float(np.sum(p*np.log(p/u)))
bkl = float(np.sum(u*np.log(u/p)))
print('size', p.size, 'sum', p.sum(), 'min', p.min(), 'max', p.max())
print('forward KL', fkl, 'err', abs(fkl-10.0))
print('backward KL', bkl, 'err', abs(bkl-10.0))
print('residual', residual(v))
np.save('/app/dist.npy', p)
print('saved')
EOF

cd /app && python3 - <<'EOF'
import numpy as np
p = np.load('/app/dist.npy')
N = 150000
print('dtype', p.dtype, 'shape', p.shape, 'ndim', p.ndim)
assert p.shape == (N,)
print('finite', np.all(np.isfinite(p)))
print('strictly positive', np.all(p > 0), 'min', p.min())
print('sum', repr(p.sum()), 'norm error', abs(p.sum()-1.0))
u = 1.0/N
fkl = float(np.sum(p*np.log(p/u)))
bkl = float(np.sum(u*np.log(u/p)))
print('forward KL', repr(fkl), 'err', abs(fkl-10.0), 'pass', abs(fkl-10.0) <= 0.001)
print('backward KL', repr(bkl), 'err', abs(bkl-10.0), 'pass', abs(bkl-10.0) <= 0.001)
# independent cross-check via scipy
from scipy.stats import entropy
print('scipy fkl', entropy(p, np.full(N, u)))
print('scipy bkl', entropy(np.full(N, u), p))
# normalization robustness: what if the checker renormalizes like scipy does
print('scipy renormalized pass', abs(entropy(p, np.full(N,u))-10)<=0.001)
print('distinct values', np.unique(p).size)
